dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with a minor asymmetrical convex deviation on the mid-left flank relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median intensity consistent with a mid-tone slate grey; uniform across the majority of the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, subtle mottling with occasional localized clusters of slightly darker pixels across the central dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual gradients between subtly darker pigmented patches and the primary grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, distinct circular depigmented mark is visible on the posterior right quadrant of the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, sharp longitudinal dorsal ridge is visible along the central axis of the posterior half, defined by high-contrast specular highlights and shadows.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a discrete, circular pale lesion or scar on the posterior right lateral-dorsal area.
